description: This file defines data models, enums, constants, and configuration classes related to Slack alerting, outages, and metrics within a larger system. It includes models for outage data, alert thresholds, alerting arguments, deployment metrics, and alert types, as well as some constants and URLs used for email headers.

classes.name: BaseOutageModel
classes.description: TypedDict representing basic outage information with alerts, alert flags, and last update timestamp.

classes.name: OutageModel
classes.description: Extends BaseOutageModel with a model_id to specify which model is affected.

classes.name: ProviderRegionOutageModel
classes.description: Extends BaseOutageModel with provider region ID and deployment IDs to specify regional outage details.

classes.name: SlackAlertingArgsEnum
classes.description: Enum defining default values for various alerting configuration parameters such as report frequency and thresholds.

classes.name: SlackAlertingArgs
classes.description: Pydantic model for configuring Slack alerting parameters, with environment variable support and descriptions.

classes.name: DeploymentMetrics
classes.description: Model for storing deployment metrics such as request failure, latency, and update time, used for reporting.

classes.name: SlackAlertingCacheKeys
classes.description: Enum for cache key strings related to deployment metrics and report status.

classes.name: AlertType
classes.description: Enum listing various alert and event types handled by the system, including LLM, budget, outage, and virtual key alerts.

classes.name: HangingRequestData
classes.description: Pydantic model representing data about hanging requests, including request ID, model, and optional metadata.
